# The Hira Store

> Handcrafted silver jewelry designed for everyday elegance. Earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets, and gift sets.

## About
The Hira Store is an online jewelry brand founded in 2023, offering premium silver and demi-fine jewelry. Each piece is crafted by artisans using ethically sourced materials. The store ships from San Jose, CA and offers free shipping on orders over $100.

## Pages
- [Shop All Jewelry](/store/shop): Browse the full catalog of 500+ handcrafted pieces with search, filters, and sorting.
- [Our Story](/store/about): The brand story, values, and craftsmanship process.
- [Homepage](/store/): Featured collections, new arrivals, and bestsellers.
